note: Rewritten from the original English description of Mjöberg 1920 (new species, original combination Hamitermes laurensis); original in English; the original describes only the soldier, the worker and the neotenic supplementary reproductives, the alate not being described, so that section is omitted. The OCR of the scanned copy read "1.05", "1.10" and "0.89" as "l.os", "l,io" and "0,S9"; these are restored here from context and letter shapes. All measurements are single values, not rangefied and not rounded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to, but clearly distinct from, H. meridionalis: the soldier head is smaller, shorter and more pale yellow, less rounded at the posterior margin and relatively wider, with the sides slightly more narrowed anteriorly; the mandibles are shorter and stouter with blunter teeth; the labrum is slightly smaller and less wide; antennal segments 3 and 4 are strongly fused and very short. The worker resembles that of H. meridionalis but is smaller, with 15 antennal segments. The nest often contains 20—30 neotenic queens.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head smaller, shorter and more pale yellow, less rounded at the posterior margin, relatively wider, with the sides slightly more narrowed anteriorly than in H. meridionalis; mandibles shorter and stouter, teeth blunter; labrum slightly smaller and narrower; antennal segments 3 and 4 strongly fused and very short. Measurements: body length with mandibles 4.7 mm, head length with mandibles 1.84 mm, head length without mandibles (to the tip of the labrum) 1.5 mm, head width 1.05 mm, pronotum length 0.32 mm, pronotum width 0.67 mm, abdomen width 1.33 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Like H. meridionalis but smaller; antennae 15-segmented. Measurements: body length 4.3 mm, head length 1.12 mm, head width 1 mm, pronotum length 0.29 mm, pronotum width 0.65 mm, abdomen width 1.39 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Neotenic supplementary reproductives: body white, with 8 pale brown tergites. Head round, compound eyes black, round and not projecting; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 very short and fused with segment 4; pronotum densely covered with long hairs, wide and short, notched at the middle of the posterior margin. Measurements: body length 10 mm, head length 1.14 mm, head width 1.10 mm, pronotum length 0.42 mm, pronotum width 0.89 mm, abdomen width 3 mm.
